about_the_game:
Wacky West is a crazy roguelite set in the Wild West! You are the sole survivor in a dangerous post-apocalyptic world. Fight hordes of mutants and zombies, collect materials, and upgrade your equipment to face the toughest bosses. In the sun-scorched Arizona desert, every day is a fight for survival! Craft increasingly powerful weapons, upgrade your gear, and save your cat - your only friend in this unforgiving world!

Save the kitten

Imagine a world where you have no support except your furry friend. Well... At least your kitten will keep you company. Except that heartless mutants have abducted your pet, and you are its last hope!

Don't give up!

Run forward and become stronger with every run. Upgrade your equipment, create new weapons, and never give up! Each run brings new upgrades and materials that will bring you closer to defeating the most dangerous bosses. As is often the case in roguelite games, the further you run, the stronger your survivor becomes.

Very Wild West

Wacky West is the wildest west on Steam. You'll need a keen eye and quick fingers to take on the toughest bosses. The atmospheric music and desert landscape of the map will provide you with the highest level of immersion. Zombies and mutants won't let you go, but they don't know that justice has looong guns!

Key features:

  • Create weapons: A unique arsenal of weapons, from auto-aiming machine guns to rocket launchers and flamethrowers.

  • Gather resources: Use everything you find along the way - scrap metal, trash, and other materials - to craft tools and weapons.

  • Fight bosses: None of them will go down without a fight. They'll throw grenades, unleash hordes of mutants, and do everything they can to stop you.

  • Traps and power-ups: Avoid dangerous barbed wire, acid puddles, and other traps. Collect useful items—both consumable and functional—that will help you throughout the game.

  • Test different modes: After defeating the final boss, you can continue playing in infinite mode, with greater challenges and double rewards.

  • Grow in strength: Upgrade your equipment, create new weapons, and unlock maps. Each game opens up new possibilities for you.

short_description: It's time to grab your revolver! You are the only survivor in a world after a nuclear disaster. Don't wait for high noon. Get moving and fight mutants and zombies to get your cat back! Collect materials, craft weapons, upgrade your gear, and show those freaks they shouldn't mess with the sheriff!
